display.title: Display Preferences
display.meta: Saved for your account in this browser, and applied the next time a screen loads.

language.label: Language
language.help: Same setting as the flag in the header — changes the sidebar and page labels.

page_size.label: Rows per page
page_size.help: What the Products, Orders, Inventory, Staff and Users tables open with. Each screen's own footer still overrides it while you are on that screen.

refresh.label: Live refresh
refresh.help: How often the Dashboard, Orders, Payments, Users and Audit screens re-poll the API. The barista queue keeps its own faster cadence so orders are never missed.
refresh.pause: Pause refreshing while this tab is in the background
refresh.pause_help: Saves API calls on a terminal left open all day.

exchange.title: Bakong Exchange Rate
exchange.meta: Used to price KHR QR payments. Stored on the server and shared by all staff.
exchange.load_failed: Could not load the exchange rate.
exchange.update_failed: Could not update the exchange rate.
